slop.prompt_used:
I'm going to paste a focus-group transcript. Tell me what the main themes are. Give me 5-7 themes with short names and brief descriptions, and one supporting quote for each.

Return JSON: [{"name": str, "description": str, "evidence": str}, ...]

themes.name: Fear of Falling Behind
themes.description: Students worry that not developing AI fluency will put them at a competitive disadvantage compared to peers who use these tools more effectively, both academically and professionally.
themes.evidence: I fear that if I don't create a relationship with AI, other people will create a relationship with AI that allows them to do things much faster, much better, much more synthesized than if I don't.

themes.name: Concerns About Cognitive Atrophy
themes.description: Participants expressed anxiety that relying on AI could diminish their critical thinking, creativity, and independent learning abilities over time.
themes.evidence: I think I feel that a lot. Like I fear that AI is making me less creative a lot.

themes.name: Professional Context Matters
themes.description: Acceptable and practical AI use varies significantly by career field, with some professions (like law) having strict limitations while others expect fluency, creating confusion about how to prepare.
themes.evidence: There are a lot of legal and ethical things around using AI with consumer data and where that data goes... The legal profession will probably be the most conservative when it comes to this type of use... Not all chat bots are created equal and not all chat bots should be used for the exact same things.
